attributeDefinitions.CAGING: Explicit presence/absence of a cage; not absence of every package or support.
attributeDefinitions.CLOSURE: Explicit opening/head/lid form; omission means neither open nor closed.
attributeDefinitions.COATING: Explicit coating state of the stated body, separate from lining.
attributeDefinitions.COLOUR: Explicit colour in a named package definition.
attributeDefinitions.COMMODITY_MATERIAL: Substance of cargo form, not the primary packaging-body material.
attributeDefinitions.CONSTRUCTION: Explicit fabrication/structural variant; no usual construction is inferred.
attributeDefinitions.CONTENTS_ARRANGEMENT: Expressly defined arrangement of contents, not a sampled quantity.
attributeDefinitions.CONTENTS_FORM: Stated contents or service form, not package-body substance.
attributeDefinitions.CONTENTS_SHAPE: Shape of stated contents, separate from the enclosing body's shape.
attributeDefinitions.COUNT_FORM: Named counting form; never a deduction that shipment quantity is one.
attributeDefinitions.COVER: Explicit presence/absence of a cover, not an assumption about an unstated lid.
attributeDefinitions.DIMENSION_CLASS: Named dimensional class without invented numeric dimensions.
attributeDefinitions.EXCLUDED_MATERIAL: Explicit excluded material; not selection of an alternative.
attributeDefinitions.FOOTPRINT: Named relative footprint; no unprinted dimensions or units are inferred.
attributeDefinitions.GROUPING: Named bundle/bunch/truss grouping alternatives; no unprinted member count.
attributeDefinitions.HANDLE: Explicit handle feature, independent of body material.
attributeDefinitions.LAYER: Named package-layer designation; the document still determines its accounting unit.
attributeDefinitions.LAYERS: Explicit number-of-layers designation of a tray/package configuration.
attributeDefinitions.LINING: Explicit presence/absence of lining; liner material remains component-owned.
attributeDefinitions.NECK: Expressly defined neck form, not an inferred closure.
attributeDefinitions.NOZZLE: Explicit nozzle feature; this alone does not establish a closing cap.
attributeDefinitions.PACKAGING_PROCESS: Explicit wrapping/treatment process, independent of package family.
attributeDefinitions.PACKING_STATE: Explicit packing state; not inference of a particular enclosure.
attributeDefinitions.POLYMER: Explicit polymer refinement of a broader plastic body material.
attributeDefinitions.POOL: Named pool; no inferred country, owner, material or dimensions.
attributeDefinitions.PRESSURIZATION: Explicit package pressure class; not measured equipment pressure.
attributeDefinitions.PROFILE: Named relative package profile, without invented dimensions.
attributeDefinitions.PROPULSION: Explicit propulsion; not fuel, DG status or document carrying role.
attributeDefinitions.PROTECTION: Explicit protected/non-protected definition; omission is not a negative.
attributeDefinitions.PURPOSE: Purpose expressly required by a definition, excluding merely typical use examples.
attributeDefinitions.RIGIDITY: Explicit rigid/flexible distinction for the stated body or component.
attributeDefinitions.RIM: Explicit rim feature; dimensional facts are represented separately.
attributeDefinitions.SHAPE: Explicit shape of the named body/component, separate from cargo contents shape.
attributeDefinitions.SIDES: Explicit side-count designation of a handling form.
attributeDefinitions.SIFT_PROOF: Explicit sift-proof statement; omission/ordinary does not imply its negation.
attributeDefinitions.SIZE: Named relative size class; no numeric dimensions are implied.
attributeDefinitions.SPOUT: Explicit spout feature, not an unstated lid/closure.
attributeDefinitions.STATUS: Administrative meaning, not a physical family or package-material fact.
attributeDefinitions.STRUCTURAL_EQUIPMENT: Explicit supporting equipment/freestanding construction of an IBC.
attributeDefinitions.TEMPERATURE_PRESSURE_CONDITION: Joint condition; no invented thresholds or setpoints.
attributeDefinitions.THERMAL_PROPERTY: Package thermal construction, not an equipment setpoint.
attributeDefinitions.TRADE_FORM: Named trade variant not safely discarded or treated as a universal synonym.
attributeDefinitions.TRANSPARENCY: Definition's explicit transparency; not implied by a generic wrapping noun.
attributeDefinitions.TRANSPORT_EQUIPMENT: Definition qualification; actual document role still needs ownership.
attributeDefinitions.WATER_RESISTANCE: Explicit water resistance; omission does not imply the opposite.
attributeDefinitions.WHEELS: Explicit wheeled construction, not an inference from every movable support.
attributeDefinitions.WOOD_TYPE: Explicit natural wood, distinct from unspecified wood/manufactured boards.

notes: This reference preserves accepted code identities and reviewed definition facts; it is not a public extraction-schema migration or alias registry.

Supplemental OASIS definitions are UNECE revision 9e adopted by UBL 2.1, not a claim that this is the newest list. Saved names remain authoritative for identity; edition differences are retained in entry notes.
Absent attributes are valid unasserted properties, never guessed negatives or requirements to choose a more-specific child.
Formal code facts and ordinary-language evidence are separate. A generic name must not automatically inherit every formal definition fact, especially those from a supplemental definition source.
Distinct codes can have equivalent properties. This reference and family/material projection do not invent a unique inverse submission code.
Measurements belong to definitions, not shipment equipment settings; unknown dimension units and pressure comparators remain unknown.
All 48 active meanings and five additional pilot families are required. Full code coverage does not enable all sampling categories or change targets.
